population.description: Adults in the United States represented by the AmeriSpeak general-population sample

arms.accessible_text: The exact fielded infographic is titled DISADVANTAGES OF BEING LOWER-CLASS. It says lower-class households have lower public-school budgets, worse medical treatment, lower hiring chances, worse fresh-food access, and less real-estate ownership than upper-class households, with the numerical comparisons displayed in the source image.

The exact fielded infographic is titled PRIVILEGES OF BEING UPPER-CLASS. It presents the reciprocal inequalities as higher public-school budgets, better medical treatment, higher hiring chances, better fresh-food access, and more real-estate ownership for upper-class households, with the numerical comparisons displayed in the source image.

common_context: View exactly one source-fielded social-class infographic before answering the question. The two randomized arms describe reciprocal aspects of the same class-inequality setting using different reference frames.
outcome_question: The level of social class inequality in the United States is unjust.
